dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey to blue-grey median intensity visible across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, subtle darker pixel clusters distributed uniformly across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between subtle mottled patches and the primary grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of fine, parallel longitudinal linear marks on the posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint longitudinal striations or rake marks visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark elliptical blowhole aperture located on the anterior dorsal midline.
